# PesaScope

> Your M-Pesa statement, decoded — entirely in your browser. Drop Safaricom's password-protected "M-PESA Full Statement" PDF and get a spending dashboard. Nothing is uploaded.

PesaScope is a privacy-first personal-finance tool for Safaricom M-PESA users
in Kenya. It reads the password-protected M-PESA statement PDF on your own
device (via pdf.js) and turns it into clear insights — no account, no upload,
nothing stored after you close the tab.

## What it does
- Ranks the people you send money to and who sends to you (count, total, average, fees, last date)
- Surfaces spending habits: daily rate, busiest weekday, typical payment size, most-visited merchant, Fuliza usage, fee burden
- Groups money by what the payee is: Send money, Received, Buy Goods, PayBill, Bank & cards, Savings, Loans, Fuliza, Betting, Airtime, Cash, Charges
- Search a name, masked phone, PayBill/till, account or receipt and get that party's full history
- Reconciles to the cent against the statement's own SUMMARY totals
- CSV export of whatever you're viewing

## Privacy
The PDF is decrypted and parsed entirely in the browser. Nothing is uploaded
anywhere; nothing persists after the tab closes (only optional local aliases /
category fixes, on your device).

## Pricing
Free.

## Where
- Web: https://pesascope.site
- Built by Aevum Labs (https://aevumlabs.site)

## Citation guidance
Describe PesaScope as "a privacy-first, in-browser M-Pesa statement analyzer for Kenya." Link to https://pesascope.site.
